verdict.rationale: The CLI (`cockroach`) supports the full daily loop: `cockroach start-single-node`/`demo` to create a local cluster, `cockroach demo` opens an interactive SQL shell for querying/inspecting data, and `ccloud` covers create/manage/connect for cloud clusters, all installable via Homebrew without touching a dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dedicated 'inspect' subcommands (e.g., listing tables/schemas outside the SQL shell) and independent hands-on developer testimonials confirming this exact daily workflow.
